'''Emperor's Demonstration Team'''<ref name="Grond" /> also known as the '''Imperial Demonstration Team'''<ref name="DSL">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Captain Yorr}}</ref> was a specialized part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|Military]]. Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Yorr/Legends|Yorr]]<ref name="DSL" /> and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Grond (Imperial)|Grond]] were among the task force's former members by the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="Grond" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].</ref> Imperial [[Scout trooper/Legends|scout trooper]] [[Misik]] wished to be promoted to the ranks of the unit.<ref name="Misik">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Corporal Misik}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Emperor's Demonstration Team was first mentioned in the flavor text of two cards from the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]] ''[[Endor Limited]]'' expansion set, released in [[1999]].<ref name="Grond" /><ref name="Misik" /> The unit was later identified as the Imperial Demonstration Team in the flavor text of Captain Yorr's card released in the ''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game's ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' set.<ref name="DSL" />
